svg.title: AgentFlow LangGraph workflow
svg.desc: The exact current graph topology: ticket validation, planning with approval, implementation and patch retry, Docker verification with repair loop, review with review-repair loop, publication approval, GitHub draft pull request, Jira update and cleanup. Invalid and retry-limit routes terminate at LangGraph END.
svg.text: Agents propose. Deterministic gates decide. Humans approve before implementation and publication.
All END chips represent LangGraph END. JiraPRWorkflowRunner determines COMPLETED, REJECTED or FAILED from the final state.
